title: yara_ruleset.v1
comment: A versioned YARA ruleset in the file-yara registry (Unit U3). promoted_by/promoted_at are HONEST attribution: null until an authorized caller promotes the row, then the actor + timestamp of that promotion. This schema deliberately carries NO signature/signer_key_id pair: the registry verifies integrity by sha256 against the content-addressed bytes, it does not verify a detached signature, so a row is never labelled 'signed'.

sha256.comment: Content address of the ruleset bytes; verified against the stored bytes on load.

promoted_by.comment: Actor that moved this row to its current status; null while still a never-promoted draft.

status.comment: Staged, authz-gated lifecycle. Only active/shadow rulesets are served to a scan worker.

target_mime_types.comment: Exact MIME type/subtype tokens, without parameters or wildcards; an empty list applies to every scanned object.

max_file_size.comment: Largest object (bytes) this ruleset should be run against.
